subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — Process Systems Engineering & Digital Twins | IIT Delhi
body_text:
Dear Professor Young,

My name is Harshith N, an undergraduate in Chemical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your group at the Industrial Information and Control Centre for a Summer 2027 visiting research internship.

I have closely followed your research in process systems engineering, dynamic process simulation, and digital twins for industrial operations. Your group's work advancing computational modeling and real-time optimization for complex chemical and energy processing systems aligns closely with my technical priorities.

In my project, Neural Process Twin, I developed physics-aware surrogate simulators in PyTorch for heat conduction, achieving real-time inference speedups while enforcing physical governing constraints. Combining this with my C++17 thermodynamic modeling tools, I am eager to assist in building high-fidelity dynamic models and simulation tooling for your ongoing industrial initiatives.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your process simulation research for 10–12 weeks in Summer 2027. My CV and research interests statement are attached, and I would be grateful for the chance to discuss potential alignment over a brief discussion.

Sincerely,
Harshith N
Undergraduate, Department of Chemical Engineering
Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
ch1251635@iitd.ac.in

subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — Reduced Basis Methods & Certified PDE Surrogates | IIT Delhi
body_text:
Dear Professor Patera,

My name is Harshith N, an undergraduate student in Chemical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). I am writing to inquire about a visiting research internship in your laboratory for 10–12 weeks in Summer 2027.

I have followed your group's foundational contributions to certified reduced basis methods, parametric PDEs, and rigorous error bounds for computational mechanics. Your emphasis on mathematical certification and provable error estimators in model order reduction provides an essential standard for reliable computational engineering.

In my numerical analysis research at IIT Delhi, I independently audited and reproduced the Krasowski et al. residual-based error estimation framework for differential equations, extending the defect solvers to soft boundary constraints. I verified pointwise error bounds without analytical solutions, and I am eager to apply this rigorous mindset to your certified surrogate modeling pipelines.

I would be delighted to contribute to your computational mechanics projects during Summer 2027. My research CV and interests statement are attached for your consideration, and I welcome any opportunity to discuss research alignment over a brief call.

Sincerely,
Harshith N

subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — High-Performance Parallel Computing & Systems | IIT Delhi
body_text:
Dear Professor Leiserson,

My name is Harshith N, an undergraduate at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). I am writing to express my strong interest in a visiting undergraduate research internship with your Supertech research group at MIT CSAIL for Summer 2027.

I have studied your group's foundational work in parallel computing, software performance engineering, and hardware-software co-design. Your rigorous methodology for diagnosing cache locality, multithreaded scalability, and algorithmic work-span bounds sets the benchmark for high-performance systems engineering.

In my project, the LLM Inference Intelligence Engine, I built empirical benchmarking tools evaluating hardware ceilings across CPU and GPU architectures. I instrumented prefill TTFT latency and decode throughput, implementing Roofline model diagnostics to isolate compute versus memory-bandwidth saturation. I am eager to apply this empirical profiling rigor to your parallel systems projects.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Supertech's performance engineering research for 10–12 weeks in Summer 2027. My CV and research interests are attached, and I would be grateful for the chance to discuss potential alignment over a brief call.

Sincerely,
Harshith N
Undergraduate, Department of Chemical Engineering
Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
ch1251635@iitd.ac.in
